data.title: Kempinski Marina Residences
data.about:
Introducing Kempinski Residences Dubai Marina, the latest prestigious addition to one of the city's most sought-after locations. Embrace luxury living at Kempinski Marina Residences Dubai, the new symbol of elegance in Dubai Marina. This development features 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as 2, 3, 4, and 5-bedroom duplexes, combining a renowned address with Kempinski's heritage. Enjoy opulent interiors, world-class amenities, and exceptional services.

Located on one of the last prime plots in Dubai Marina, Kempinski Residences Dubai Marina promises an unparalleled luxury living experience. Operated by Kempinski, a name synonymous with excellence since 1897, these residences offer stunning marina and city views, exquisite interiors, and world-class amenities. Experience bespoke services and lavish comfort, making Kempinski Residences Dubai Marina the ultimate address for sophisticated living. For more information, contact us to learn about Kempinski Residences Dubai Marina prices and availability.
